svg.title: Multi-tenant Loki on AKS with OpenTelemetry: the whole picture
svg.text: Multi-tenant Loki on AKS with OpenTelemetry: the whole picture
Tenants never pick their tenant: OpenTelemetry collectors decide it, the read gateway decides who sees it
WRITE PATH: OPENTELEMETRY, WITH KAFKA BETWEEN THE COLLECTOR TIERS
frontend → scheduler → queriers; ruler → metrics store
Tenant pods reach only their node's OTel agent: never the gateway, Loki or Grafana's backends
